title: From Sequence Uncertainty to Phenotype Hypotheses: Uncertainty-Conditioned Inference over Biomedical Knowledge Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2611.25422v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Genomic foundation models provide variant-level evidence, but connecting that evidence to phenotype hypotheses requires accounting for uncertainty throughout structured reasoning. We introduce an uncertainty-conditioned path-energy framework that converts sequence predictions and calibrated predictive uncertainty into explicit distributions over graph-supported phenotype hypotheses, without patient-level phenotype supervision. An interpretable learned energy scores admissible gene--disease--phenotype routes, query uncertainty controls the target temperature, and path probabilities are aggregated into phenotype hypotheses. This formulation makes evidence quality an explicit determinant of hypothesis breadth while retaining traceable multi-path support. Exact normalization over enumerable candidate sets provides a reference for evaluating a Hastings-corrected learned revision operator. On AlzKB and Hetionet, phenotype-level entropy tracks

translated_title: 从序列不确定性到表型假设：生物医学知识图谱上的不确定性条件化推断
translated_abstract: 基因组基础模型能够提供变异层面的证据，但要将这些证据与表型假设联系起来，需要在整个结构化推理过程中考虑不确定性。我们提出了一种不确定性条件化的路径能量框架，该框架将序列预测和经过校准的预测不确定性转化为图谱支持的表型假设上的显式分布，且无需患者层面的表型监督。一个可解释的学习能量函数对可接受的基因—疾病—表型路径进行评分，查询不确定性控制目标温度，路径概率被聚合为表型假设。这一公式化方法使证据质量成为假设广度的显式决定因素，同时保留了可追溯的多路径支持。对可枚举候选集的精确归一化为评估经Hastings修正的学习修订算子提供了参考基准。在AlzKB和Hetionet上，表型层面的熵追踪……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种不确定性条件化的路径能量框架，将基因组基础模型的序列预测及其校准不确定性转化为生物医学知识图谱上可解释、可追溯的表型假设分布，无需患者级表型监督。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an uncertainty-conditioned path-energy framework that converts genomic foundation model sequence predictions and calibrated predictive uncertainty into interpretable, traceable phenotype hypothesis distributions over biomedical knowledge graphs, without requiring patient-level phenotype supervision.
